; secondary-pen-toolbar: show the built-in "Secondary pen" in the toolbar.
;
; xochitl already has a second pen (own tool, colour and size, remembered per
; document), but it only shows when the toolbar's slot logic puts it in the main
; row. On small screens (Paper Pro Move) it always loses its slot and hides itself.
;
; This adds a dedicated instance of xochitl's own SecondaryPenMenu right after the
; main editing tools, independent of the slot logic.

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > Item#toolbar > GridLayout#toolLayout
        LOCATE AFTER Repeater#editingTools
        INSERT {
            SecondaryPenMenu {
                id: pinnedSecondaryPen
                objectName: "pinnedSecondaryPenMenu"
                toolbar: root
                type: ToolbarTool.Type.ToolbarButton
                group: ToolbarModel.Editing
                antialiasing: root.antialiasing
                visible: root.expanded
                onSelect: (tool) => root._select(tool)
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
